perspective:
From Bradley Ochoa’s perspective, he has access to the following information:

- He is Bradley Ochoa, a salesperson at a marketing firm. He knows Katherine Lasiloo as his colleague and the marketing manager. Their professional relationship is generally cordial but has been strained by disagreements over sales versus marketing strategy.
- In the meeting room, he had prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales techniques. He told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but believed traditional methods deserved more consideration. He heard Katherine say the market is evolving and digital outreach matters, and she asked how he reconciled his data with rising online engagement. He replied that he did not want to abandon digital but felt proven methods were being sidelined. He heard Katherine propose analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital-campaign success stories showing increased engagement and sales. Bradley asked how those strategies were developed. He heard her say it was about targeting the right audience with the right message and that she would walk him through the analytics and decision-making. He admitted his doubts and growing interest in digital. He heard her welcome his openness and suggest going deeper into the data. He internally felt uncertain and began questioning his exclusive support for traditional methods.
- Bradley proposed a joint strategy session combining traditional and digital marketing. He heard Katherine agree, saying combining strengths could improve results and suggesting they schedule time to brainstorm. He expressed hope that leveraging both their expertise would be impactful and thanked her for collaborating.
- After a successful joint meeting, he felt excited and worked overtime to draft a board presentation integrating both their ideas. He told Katherine about the draft. He heard her praise it as comprehensive and well thought out and note his hard work. He said he believed the integrated approach would set them apart and wanted to nail the presentation. She expressed confidence and suggested fine-tuning.
- After the presentation succeeded and the new strategy was implemented, he felt grateful for his growth and the collaboration. He thanked Katherine, said he had learned from her, and proposed regular strategy sessions. He heard Katherine agree, say the project came to fruition, credit his openness, and support regular sessions to stay on top of their game and market trends.

He does not have access to Katherine’s private thoughts, her personality type, her education, or any events/statements he did not observe or hear.
